claims.description: Adding, removing, or editing style elements invalidates cached layout snapshots.

notes.text: Package-contract tests verify snapshot invalidation when `style` elements are added, removed, or edited.

claims.description: Inserting, changing, or deleting CSSOM rules invalidates cached layout snapshots.

notes.text: Per-sheet value revisions invalidate parsed CSS; separate structural revisions trigger rule-object discovery only after rule insertion, removal, or replacement. Document stylesheet membership and authored text are cached behind MutationObserver delivery/takeRecords. Sheet identity, disabled state, and adopted-sheet ordering remain checked. Non-patchable CSSOM retains content fingerprinting.
